title: Flexible Automotive Power Management
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: Due to the ongoing electrification, the dissemination of entertainment systems, and the growing importance of autonomous driving functions, the relevance of the automotive power network is increasing. In this work, an auction-based automotive power management is investigated, formalized, and extended to support flexible integration of updated hardware and thereby a sustainable vehicle platform. The presented approach achieves effective power distribution between all components in the vehicle.
